title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3 code execution was possible in untrusted projects via the Terraform File…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA prior to version 2026.3 allows code execution in untrusted projects via the Terraform File Watchers feature. This flaw could enable an attacker to execute arbitrary code with high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
